paths.title: B.Tech Computer Science Engineering
paths.why_it_fits: Provides a comprehensive engineering foundation including systems, software, and mathematics; compare total cost per institution against the student's stated budget preference.
tradeoffs: Curriculum may be rigid, leaving limited time for specialized AI/ML exploration in early years.
Requires balancing heavy academic requirements with self-directed project building.

milestones.timeframe: Until JEE preparation ends; date not stated in the profile
milestones.focus: Maintain basic programming consistency within the 5-10 hour weekly limit.
Transition to systematic software engineering foundations.
projects: Build a personal git-tracked project repository
Build a relational database for student records

milestones.focus: Classical machine learning and data evaluation.
projects: Build a classification model for a public census dataset
Build a data pipeline module for an external dataset
Build an end-to-end ML service with automated evaluation

internship_strategy.readiness: Student can independently clean a raw dataset, train a scikit-learn model, and document its performance using precision and recall metrics.
preparation: Build a portfolio of three distinct, documented ML projects
internship_strategy.application_stage: Begin applying once the student can independently explain basic model metrics and demonstrate a working project; this may occur around Year 2 depending on progress.

paths.title: B.Sc Mathematics and Computing
paths.why_it_fits: Deep focus on mathematical reasoning and algorithm implementation provides a distinct foundation for AI; compare total cost per institution against the student's stated budget preference.
tradeoffs: Less emphasis on full-stack software engineering compared to B.Tech.
Requires significant self-directed effort to learn production deployment tools.

milestones.timeframe: Until JEE preparation ends; date not stated in the profile
milestones.focus: Consistent practice of mathematical problem solving and basic coding.
projects: Build a script to solve mathematical sequences
Build a simulation of a physical process

milestones.focus: Deep mathematical understanding of machine learning foundations.
projects: Build a linear regression model from scratch using matrix algebra
Build an analysis tool for high-dimensional datasets
Build a module for reproducible data preprocessing

milestones.focus: System design and production ML workflows.
projects: Build a portfolio of production-ready AI models with automated evaluation

internship_strategy.readiness: Student can implement classic ML algorithms from scratch using only numerical libraries and evaluate them against library implementations.
preparation: Write detailed documentation for mathematical implementations of ML algorithms
internship_strategy.application_stage: Begin applying once the student can demonstrate custom implementation of core ML algorithms and a successful data project; this may occur around Year 2 depending on progress.
